// Finite owned-library diagnostic. Secrets are accepted only on stdin.
package main
import("bytes";"context";"crypto/rand";"encoding/json";"fmt";"io";"math/big";"net/http";"os";"regexp";"strconv";"time";"light-media/internal/fnos")
type Input struct {Host,Username,Password,GUID,Root,Mode string}
type Env struct {Code *int `json:"code"`;Data json.RawMessage `json:"data"`}
type Trace struct {Stage string `json:"stage"`;HTTP int `json:"http"`;Code *int `json:"code"`;Truthy bool `json:"truthy"`}
func main(){var in Input;if json.NewDecoder(os.Stdin).Decode(&in)!=nil||in.Host!="https://nas.accidia.top:5667/v"||(in.Mode!="read_task"&&(!regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{32}$`).MatchString(in.GUID)||!regexp.MustCompile(`^/vol2/1000/media/light-media-m0-test-[0-9a-f-]{36}$`).MatchString(in.Root))){panic("invalid owned input")};ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),60*time.Second);defer cancel(); c:=&http.Client{Timeout:12*time.Second,CheckRedirect:func(*http.Request,[]*http.Request)error{return http.ErrUseLastResponse}};token:=""; traces:=[]Trace{};call:=func(stage,method,path string,body any)Env {var payload []byte;if body!=nil{payload,_=json.Marshal(body)};n,_:=rand.Int(rand.Reader,big.NewInt(900000));r,e:=http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx,method,in.Host+"/api/v1"+path,bytes.NewReader(payload));if e!=nil{panic("request failed")};r.Header.Set("Content-Type","application/json");r.Header.Set("Referer",in.Host);r.Header.Set("authx",fnos.Signature("/v/api/v1"+path,string(payload),strconv.FormatInt(n.Int64()+100000,10),strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixMilli(),10)));if token!=""{r.Header.Set("Authorization",token)};res,e:=c.Do(r);if e!=nil{panic("transport failed")};defer res.Body.Close();raw,e:=io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(res.Body,2<<20));if e!=nil{panic("read failed")};var env Env;if json.Unmarshal(raw,&env)!=nil{panic("invalid envelope")};var value any;_ = json.Unmarshal(env.Data,&value);truth:=truthy(value);traces=append(traces,Trace{stage,res.StatusCode,env.Code,truth});return env};ok:=func(env Env)bool{return env.Code!=nil&&*env.Code==0};login:=call("login","POST","/login",map[string]string{"username":in.Username,"password":in.Password,"app_name":"trimemedia-web"});if !ok(login){panic("login failed")};var session struct{Token string `json:"token"`};_ = json.Unmarshal(login.Data,&session);token=session.Token;if token==""{panic("no session")};user:=call("user","GET","/user/info",nil);var u struct{Admin int `json:"is_admin"`};_ = json.Unmarshal(user.Data,&u);if !ok(user)||u.Admin!=1{panic("not admin")};if in.Mode=="read_task"{env:=call("task_running","GET","/task/running",nil);var value any;_ = json.Unmarshal(env.Data,&value);out,_:=json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"traces":traces,"data_shape":shape(value)},"","  ");fmt.Println(string(out));return};ls:=call("libraries","GET","/mdb/list",nil);var libs []struct{GUID string `json:"guid"`;Dirs []string `json:"dir_list"`};_ = json.Unmarshal(ls.Data,&libs);found:=false;for _,l:=range libs{if l.GUID==in.GUID&&len(l.Dirs)==1&&(l.Dirs[0]==in.Root||l.Dirs[0]==in.Root+"/"){found=true}};if !ok(ls)||!found{panic("owned library not verified")};call("old_json_without_preflight","POST","/mdb/scan/"+in.GUID,map[string][]string{"dir_list":{in.Root+"/movie"}});call("source_task_running","GET","/task/running",nil);call("source_empty_post","POST","/mdb/scan/"+in.GUID,nil);b,_:=json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"classification":"actual finite diagnostic; only newly owned library; original-protocol comparison, not SDK acceptance","library_id":in.GUID,"traces":traces},"","  ");fmt.Println(string(b))}

func shape(v any)any{switch x:=v.(type){case nil:return nil;case bool:return x;case float64:return x;case string:return "<string>";case []any:out:=[]any{};for _,c:=range x{out=append(out,shape(c))};return out;case map[string]any:out:=map[string]any{};for k,c:=range x{out[k]=shape(c)};return out};return "<other>"}

func truthy(v any)bool{switch x:=v.(type){case nil:return false;case bool:return x;case string:return x!="";case float64:return x!=0;case []any:return len(x)>0;case map[string]any:return len(x)>0};return false}
